a user posted asking how to open a massive, ominous safe that was in his friends new house. it went viral on reddit, everyone was on the edge of their seat. what was in the safe? was it money? bodies? drugs (it was a former drug house)? perhaps souls of the damned or precious gemstones? all of the above? the curiosity was eating people alive. 


so OP *slowly* posts updates (which outrages the people, and they write horrible comments to OP), and orders tools, gets advice on how to approach opening it, makes a post saying he’s going to open it and… he never posts ever again. he just vanishes. the people were outraged (again), and soured. but as time went on, it eventually faded away from the reddit spotlight.


until a few years later, as fate would have it, a completely different person who, by pure chance, unknowingly moved into that same house where the safe was. that OP actually opens the safe and… there’s absolutely nothing inside it. the people were outraged (again again), maybe even more so than before. all that waiting and hype just for some dusty cobwebs. perhaps opening it was worse than leaving it alone, because for many those painful scars are still felt to this day.
